name: Resume tailor
oneLine: Your resume fitted to one job, plus cover letter.
forWho: Job seekers who want each application to fit the post without making things up.
youGet: A table of how you match the job
A tailored resume that hiring software can read
woah: It found the match I didn't know how to say.
whyBetter: Plain Claude invents numbers and stuffs in skills you don't have. This uses only your real experience and shows your gaps honestly.
tryPrompt: Tailor my resume to this job and write a short cover letter. Job post and resume below:
